title: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
description: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?

mainQuestExcel.title: Dimming Mushroom's Call for Help
mainQuestExcel.description: You hear strange sounds — voices, almost — coming from a giant mushroom in The Chasm. Could it be... a giant talking mushroom?

flow.stepDescription: Give Xamaran some of the Adjuvant's power

dialogs.text: You lend the energy of the Adjuvant to Xamaran.
Whoa! Sheeshroom is glowing. Should Paimon call it a "Shiningroom" now?
#Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!
#Thanks to {NICKNAME}, and thanks to Paimon also! Xamaran life-light is rekindled!
But do not let your guard down yet. Xamaran knows that the foul energy is not yet eradicated. It could strike back at any time.
Huh? Then what do we do!?
Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?

flow.stepDescription: Help Xamaran clear the foul energy out

dialogs.text: Xamaran knows that the foul energy has yet to be eradicated. Two-legged one, please lend Xamaran your strength.
Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?

flow.stepDescription: Tell Xamaran that the foul energy has been cleansed

dialogs.text: #Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!
None answered Xamaran's call for help. The many-legged and four-legged paid no heed, and the two-legged turned a deaf ear.
#Only the wise would answer. Paimon proved to be one with wisdom, and {NICKNAME} did, too.
You two, wisest of the two-legged, shall receive Xamaran's gratitude.
Hmph, Paimon the Wise is not to be taken lightly!
It was no trouble.
#Given time, {NICKNAME} and Paimon will rise to become as great as Xamaran and its kin. This Xamaran knows for sure.
Hang on, what is that supposed to mean?
The many-legged are inferior to the four-legged, and the four-legged are inferior to the two-legged, so naturally, the two-legged are inferior to the legless.
#But what {NICKNAME} and Paimon lack by nature, you can make up for through hard work. You might even be able to change the course of fate one day.
Wow, this glowing mushroom's talking super big! Paimon wonders if glowing mushrooms make good cooking ingredients...
For Chicken-Mushroom Skewers, surely.
Beautiful mushrooms lie. This one could be poisonous.
A glutton, this Paimon is. A bite on the mushroom today, another bite tomorrow, and a hundred days later, there shall be no Paimon left in Paimon, but only mushrooms.
#Uhh, Sheeshroom's starting to talk all creepy, {NICKNAME}...
Ah, so you failed to see the humor in that. A shame.
That wasn't funny at all!
Xamaran is cleared of the foul energy, yet its kin still suffer. Xamaran lacks the strength now to shelter the weak like it once did.
#Please, {NICKNAME}, Xamaran begs of you. Exercise your benevolence and save the defenseless.
#Do you mean there are more ill mushrooms? {NICKNAME}, let's help 'em, shall we?
Now that we're here...
As long as it's not a big detour.
Then let's be off!
Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?
#Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!
If Xamaran may be so bold, you Two-Legs do have a saying: "A helping hand must see things to the end."
You mean more errand-running, huh?
But do human sayings really apply to mushrooms?
Amongst Two-Legs, you two do indeed deserve the title of "The Wise."
We are both living beings bathing in the blessings of the earth. It's natural for us to help each other out.
Please take this — the Blessings of Wisdom.
You obtain the Blessings of Wisdom.
Wow... What's this? It looks kinda suspicious, actually...
Xamaran can smell the lingering scent of foul energy in the air but cannot tell where its source lies. Follow the water and you shall find it.
#You merely need to use the Blessings of Wisdom on the source, {NICKNAME}, and Xamaran's kin will take care of the rest.
The source of the foul energy... That's indeed something that can't be left unattended.
...But why don't you deal with it yourself?
#{NICKNAME}, you are far more humorous than Paimon. Xamaran doesn't have legs whereas you do. As one of the legless, Xamaran shan't meddle too much with the matters of the Two-Legs.
What's more, Xamaran has a greater duty to perform.
A greater duty?
Xamaran has spent too much strength. It was a pleasant conversation with you two, but Xamaran must rest now and gather the strength to fend off evil and provide a shelter for its kin to prosper.
#{NICKNAME} and Paimon, may you be blessed on your journey ahead.
Hey, Sheeshroom! Wake up!
#{NICKNAME}, looks like Sheeshroom has gone to sleep. Well, let's head off then.
Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?

flow.stepDescription: Follow the water's flow and search for the source of the foul energy
Use the Blessings of Wisdom on the source of the foul energy
Tell Xamaran that the foul energy's source has been cleared out

dialogs.text: Hey, Sheeshroom, we're back. We've run out of your — um, what do you call it — oh, your Blessings of Wisdom.
But we've managed to block the fissures. Now the problem has been solved!
#Hail {NICKNAME}! Hail Paimon!
May no regrets linger in the night bygone. May all shadows fade ere the dawn to come.
Seems Sheeshroom has fallen asleep again. Let's not disturb it.
Whoa! Where did all this black mud come from? Is it the "foul energy" that Sheeshroom talked about?
